name: Minimal Motion Studio
short_description: A brand-to-website studio: a structured brief becomes contrast-checked tokens, type and spacing scales, component variants and Web Animations motion, previewed at three widths and exported as a dependency-free package that builds byte-identical to the preview.
capabilities: One JSON Schema brief contract shared by the browser (Ajv) and the GitHub harness (jsonschema)
OKLCH palette derivation; every foreground/background pairing the stylesheet uses is checked, adjustments are listed, and the build re-checks them
Type and spacing scales, component variants and four motion presets on the Web Animations API, with a reduced-motion preview
Phone, tablet and desktop previews of the exact exported page in a sandboxed frame
Exported package with no dependencies: npm run build regenerates tokens CSS, re-checks contrast and writes one page with a hash-based CSP
Published generation runs build the package independently and review it with Playwright and axe-core at three widths
Owner-only AI-proposed briefs through GitHub Actions: the model returns data only and a secret-free job verifies it before the ordinary run
data_limitations: Exports use system font stacks, so typography varies by device
AI-proposed briefs need an inference secret the owner configures; none is configured, so none has run
The history shows a snapshot of the state branch, not live data
